1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5 4.Bg5 Ne4 5.Nx.strategy: Protects the bishop on g5 and the d4 pawn in one move, and clears the d1 square so that White can castle long. White develops calmly and plans to undermine the pawn on e4 rather than hurry.

Strikes at d4 straight away: with the queen on d8 also looking at it, the pawn is attacked twice and defended only by the queen. White must resolve the centre now, while Black keeps the cramping pawn on e4.
1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 d5 4.Bg5 Ne4 5.Nx.name: Grünfeld Defence: Lundin Variation
